messages:
anya: Heads-up — last night's benchmark run (nightly-bench-v2) came back RED. Several shards failed during artifact upload to S3 with a WriteTimeout. Can infra oncall take a look? s3 path: s3://bench-artifacts/nightly/2026-03-10/shard-12/

sam: I saw this. uploader threw WriteTimeout ~45s, CI retried once then marked job failed. Retries didn't help. Logs on build host: /var/log/bench/uploader/2026-03-10-12.log

michael: Can we rerun only the failed shards instead of the whole suite? job id: nightly-bench-v2-20260310-45

anya: Prefer shard-rerun to save GPU cycles. @lina can you queue the rerun? If not, I'll take it.

lina: I can queue it. starting rerun for shards [12,13,14] now — queue id q1234. will post results here.

devops-bot: Incident created: #INC-20260310-UploaderTimeout — pinging eng-infra oncall.

sam: Quick triage note: root cause might be NFS flakiness on the worker that buffers uploads, or S3 throttling on our side. small log excerpt:
```
UploadError: WriteTimeout after 45000ms
  at uploader.upload (/opt/rd/uploader/index.js:78)
  at processChunk (/opt/rd/uploader/index.js:45)
  shard=12 chunk=3
```

michael: I also see a spike in 5xxs from s3-proxy metrics around 02:00-02:10 UTC. @infra can you check network egress and proxy health for that window?

sam: Short-term workaround proposal: bump uploader timeout to 90s and add one more retry. Patch suggestion:
```diff
--- a/uploader/config.yml
+++ b/uploader/config.yml
@@
- timeout_ms: 30000
- retries: 2
+ timeout_ms: 90000
+ retries: 3
```

anya: Let's not push the config change to prod yet. Can we canary it? If rerun proves flaky host, we should cordon the host first. @lina please run rerun and collect profiler + /metrics dump.

lina: rerun q1234 started. attaching profiler link when it's available. ETA ~15m.

devops-bot: rerun complete: q1234 — shards 12,13 succeeded; shard 14 failed again with WriteTimeout.

sam: shard 14 repeated failure. can someone dump full uploader logs for worker host bench-worker-9 and check dmesg? Hostname likely the issue.

michael: grabbing logs now, link: https://logs.redwood.example/bench/worker-9/2026-03-10/uploader.log

anya: Quick bisect idea: run shard 14 with smaller shard-size/chunk-size to see if packet size correlates. Also check disk and kernel errors on bench-worker-9: `df -h` and `dmesg | tail`.

lina: disk space is fine but I see intermittent `EIO` in dmesg just before upload starts. opening infra ticket to inspect rack/drive: TICKET-IR-452.

sam: sounds like flaky hardware then. For triage notes: rerun recovered most failures but one host is suspect. recommend cordoning bench-worker-9 until infra confirms.

michael: opened a small PR to canary the config bump on staging and document the rerun steps: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench/pull/321

anya: Thanks everyone. @eng-infra oncall please confirm cordon + follow-up. tagging for visibility :eyes:
